# QoF v1.7.0's "Hands On" Update

> [!NOTE]
> A Minecraft Bedrock addon that adds small vanilla-friendly features. Each module is configurable through the in-game pack settings panel.

## Changelog

- Refactored the codebase to improve maintainability and make future development easier
- Renamed the `Double Door` module to `Openable`, with additional functionality
- Added two new modules `Bonemeal+` and `Farm Guard`
- Added support for custom dimensions from both *Mojang* and *other add-ons*
- Expanded and improved the usage of `swing` across more interactions

### **(new) Bonemeal+**

Allows players to use bonemeal on more blocks, introducing additional ways to grow and interact with plants.

| **Block**    | **Effect**                                     |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------- |
| Cactus       | Grows cactus, with a chance to produce flowers |
| Nether Wart  | Advances nether wart growth                    |
| Vine         | Grows vines downward (up to 32 blocks)         |
| Melon Stem   | Has a chance to spawn a melon                  |
| Pumpkin Stem | Has a chance to spawn a pumpkin                |
| Chorus Plant | Promotes chorus plant growth                   |

### **(new) Farm Guard**

Protects farmland from being trampled. The protection activates when:
- The player is sneaking
- The player is wearing boots with Feather Falling

## Carried Container

- `fixed` Fixed an issue where double containers could swap halves when placing a carried container

### Openable

- Expanded support beyond doors. Now also supports `fence gates` and `trapdoors`
- Opening an *openable* while sneaking will no longer trigger neighboring openables
- `new` Added door knocking. Hit a door to knock on it. Jumping while hitting makes the knock louder!
- `new` Added shop doorbells. Place a bell near a door, and it will ring when a player opens the door
- Improved how neighboring doors are detected
- `new config` Added `Auto Close`, which automatically closes doors, fence gates, and trapdoors after a set time when no one is nearby
- `new config` Added `Open Iron Door by Hand`

### Dynamic Light

- `fixed` Dynamic light will no longer interfere with `cactus`, `floating blocks`, `grass_path`, or `scaffolding`
- `fixed` Fixed interactions that could not be performed near dynamic light sources
- `new config` Added `Light Source Priority`, allowing players to choose how light sources are prioritized:
  - Prefer Brightest `(default)`
  - Prefer Mainhand
  - Prefer Offhand (including fire from entities)
  - Combined (Sum)
  - Combined (Hypotenuse) `(previous system)`

### Offhand

- `new config` Added `Offhand Block Placement`, allowing players to choose which blocks can be placed using the offhand:
  - Disabled
  - Torches Only `(default)`
  - All Blocks

> [!NOTE]
>
> **The Offhand Situation is Insane :ALERT:**
>
> Mojang is already experimenting with native `offhand functionality` in [Minecraft Bedrock Preview](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/minecraft-preview-26-70-26)!
>
> **QoF's custom offhand feature will be removed in a future update** as Bedrock moves toward native offhand support.
>
> I'm [aitji](https://aitji.xyz), and you're up to date!

### Harvest

- `fixed` Melon and pumpkin stems will no longer break when harvesting their crops
- `fixed` Fixed an issue where harvested items were not consumed correctly

### Composter+

- Added a swing animation when using items on composters

### Recipe+

#### Craft

- Cobblestone and blackstone can now be mixed when crafting recipes that use either material
- Added a recipe to craft a dispenser using a dropper and a bow

#### Stone Cutter

- Added a glass cutting recipe that produces `3 Glass Panes`

### Cauldron+

- `Added` support for washing potions off tipped arrows
- `Added` support for additional blocks and items introduced alongside the Minecraft update

| Item            | Dye                 | Clean                 |
| --------------- | ------------------- | --------------------- |
| Wool Slab       | `#` Wool Slab       | White Wool Slab       |
| Wool Stairs     | `#` Wool Stairs     | White Wool Stairs     |
| Concrete Slab   | `#` Concrete Slab   | White Concrete Slab   |
| Concrete Stairs | `#` Concrete Stairs | White Concrete Stairs |
| Cushion         | `#` Cushion         | White Cushion         |
| Candle          | `#` Candle          | Candle                |

> **Notes**
>
> - `#` represents any of the 16 supported dye colors\
> - Concrete Powder hardens into Concrete when dyed or cleaned

### Hardens Concrete Powder

- `Added` support for using Potions to harden Concrete Powder into Concrete
- Splash Potions can harden multiple Concrete Powder blocks within their area of effect
- Lingering Potions can continuously harden Concrete Powder blocks while their area effect cloud remains active. Each successful conversion reduces the cloud's remaining duration

### Mob Loot+

- `Added` new drops to various mobs
- `Added` support for fire-dependent drops, including cooked meat and alternative items
- `Added` additional drops to mobs that previously had no unique drops

| Mob              | Additional Drops              |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Goat             | Mutton                        |
| Piglin Brute     | Gilded Blackstone             |
| Sniffer          | Moss Block, Moss Carpet       |
| Vex              | Iron Sword                    |
| Silverfish       | String                        |
| Wolf             | Bone                          |
| Armadillo        | Spider Eye, Armadillo Scute   |
| Ocelot           | String                        |
| Axolotl          | Tropical Fish                 |
| Allay            | Amethyst Shard                |
| Villager         | Emerald, Leather Armor        |
| Zombie Villager  | Emerald                       |
| Camel            | Leather                       |
| Wandering Trader | Emerald, Leather Armor        |
| Happy Ghast      | Ghast Tear                    |
| Endermite        | Popped Chorus Fruit           |
| Ender Dragon     | Dragon Head, Phantom Membrane |
| Warden           | Echo Shard                    |

> [!NOTE]
> 
> Some drops are exclusive to adult mobs\
> Mobs killed while on fire may drop cooked or alternative items instead\
> Looting enchantments can increase drop quantities\
> Some mobs have a chance to drop nothing

### Recipe+

#### Stone Cutter

- `Glass` can now be cut into `Glass Panes x3`

##### Wools

`Added` the following Stonecutter recipes for Wool:

- Wool Slab `x2`
- Wool Stairs `x1`
- Cushion `x1`

##### Woods

- `Added` Ladder recipes for all woods types
- `Added` support for the new Poplar wood type

#### Shaped

- `Blaze Powder x2` can now be crafted into a `Blaze Rod`
- `Wind Charge x4` can now be crafted into a `Breeze Rod`
- a `Clay Blocks` can now be crafted into `Clay x4`
- a `Web` can now be crafted into `String x4`
- `String x9` can now be crafted into a `Web`

##### Slabs

`Added` recipes for converting the following slabs back into their full blocks:

- `Poplar Slab` to `Poplar Planks`
- `Polished Cinnabar Slab` to `Polished Cinnabar`
- `Cinnabar Brick Slab` to `Cinnabar Brick`
- `Polished Sulfur Slab` to `Polished Sulfur`
- `Sulfur Brick Slab` to `Sulfur Brick`

#### Shapeless

- `Carpet x3` can now be crafted into a `Wool`
- `Moss Carpet x3` can now be crafted into a `Moss Block`
- `Pale Moss Carpet x3` can now be crafted into a `Pale Moss Block`
- a `Glowstone` can now be crafted into `Glowstone Dust x4`
- a `Water Potion` and `Sugar x3` can now be crafted into a `Honey Bottle`
- a `Pink Petals` and a `Bone Meal` can now be crafted into `Pink Petals x2`
- a `Pink Wild Flowers` and a `Bone Meal` can now be crafted into `Pink Wild Flowers x2`
- `Fermented Spider Eyes` can now be crafted using `Crimson Fungus, Red Mushrooms, Shelf Mushrooms, or Warped Fungus`

#### Smelting

- All `Copper variants` can now be smelted into `Copper Nuggets`
- All `Iron variants` can now be smelted into `Iron Nuggets`
- `Concrete` can now be smelted into `Concrete Powder`
